class.name: VoxelGenerator4D
class.brief_description: Abstract base class for 4D voxel content generators.
class.description: A VoxelGenerator4D produces the voxel content that fills a [VoxelData4D] volume: the material of any voxel, and the surface normal and crossing position wherever the generated surface crosses the voxel grid's edges. Each subclass generates one kind of content, configured by the parameters it is instantiated with. Generators are currently only usable from C++ code.
